subject: Pricing follow-up: token economics & target $/1M
messages:
From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Pricing follow-up: token economics & target $/1M

Hi Samir — great to meet today, and thanks for walking through Acme's call/assistant roadmap. Quick recap and a few follow-ups so we can put together a tailored pricing/scenario pack.

Recap (from my notes):
- Primary use case: customer support assistant (multi-turn conversations) + nightly batch summarization of support transcripts.
- Expected monthly volume: broad range; you're in discovery but noted seasonality and a planned ramp in Q1.
- Compliance/Security: SOC2 required, regional restriction to us-east for PII handling.
- SLA: low-latency for support flows (target 200\u2013400ms p95), can tolerate higher latency for batch jobs.

What we need from you (short answers are fine):
1) Estimated monthly token volumes (split by prompt vs completion if possible) for the next 3\u20136 months.
2) Target unit economics: what's your target $/1M tokens (or budget band) that would make us attractive vs your current providers?
3) Current spend and provider: are you currently running on OpenAI, Anthropic, self-hosted, or a mix? What's your current effective $/1M?
4) Any constraints on commit length (12/24 months) or procurement PO requirements we should know about.

To help the conversation, I attached a simple template you can drop numbers into — will use that to produce 3 pricing scenarios (hosted, dedicated reserved, private). We'll also include a benchmarking plan vs OpenAI/Anthropic and common open-model hosts so you can compare effective $/1M once we include batching, KV cache hit rates, and tail latency needs.

High-level benchmark reference (illustrative ranges only):
- Typical hosted LLM hosts (managed): ~$15\u201325 / 1M tokens (varies by model & SLA)
- Anthropic: comparable range depending on model and performance profile
- Open-model hosts / self-managed: can get lower infra unit costs (~$6\u201312 / 1M) but total cost depends on ops and performance tuning

If you can send the numbers today or tomorrow, I'll get a draft pricing pack over by Wednesday. Marissa and Aditya are looped for pricing/prereq checks.

Thanks — talk soon.

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: token economics & target $/1M

Vanessa — thanks for the recap and the template. Attached is our rough estimate. Key numbers:
- Monthly tokens (current estimate):
  - Support assistant (interactive): ~50M prompt tokens / month and ~150M completion tokens / month (peak planning over next 6 months).
  - Batch summarization: ~200M tokens / month but can be scheduled off-peak.
- Current effective cost: we're paying roughly ~$18 / 1M with our current managed provider (model & plan mix).
- Target: to make a switch we need effective unit economics in the ~$8\u201310 / 1M range (after considering SLA and QA).
- Procurement: 12-month commit preferred, will consider 24-month if pricing improves; standard PO process, no unusual legal items.

I've attached our spreadsheet (acme_token_estimates.xlsx) — it's very rough but should be enough for scenario modeling. Happy to jump on a short call if needed.

Thanks,

Acme Corp

Samir — appreciate the numbers, that helped a lot. I reviewed with Marissa and Aditya this morning and attached a concise pricing scenarios PDF. High-level response to your target:

- Quick assessment: with your volumes and a 12-month commit we can be competitive in the $8\u201310 / 1M band using Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) + batching/cache optimizations. For hosted offering with immediate onboarding, our public hosted tiers land a bit higher (~$12\u201316 / 1M) depending on model choice and latency SLOs.

- Competitor comparison (effective $/1M, illustrative):
  - OpenAI (managed enterprise): ~ $15\u201322 / 1M (model-dependent, includes managed infra + licensing)
  - Anthropic (managed): ~ $14\u201320 / 1M
  - Open-model hosts / self-managed (infra-only): ~ $6\u201312 / 1M (but requires ops & tuning)

Recommendation / next steps:
1) I'll send an official pricing proposal with 3 scenarios: hosted trial (30 days), Dedicated reserved (12-mo commit) with target $/1M around $9 (conditional on KV cache hit rates >= 20% and typical batching patterns), and a private deployment estimate (procurement lead time longer).
2) Run a short benchmark: we can mirror a subset of your traffic (non-PII) for 48\u201372 hours to validate latency and effective $/1M after caching/batching. We have a benchmark invite link here: https://redwood.storage/benchmarks/acme-benchmark-invite
3) If the benchmark validates performance, Marissa will produce the formal pricing/contract; Aditya will coordinate any technical kickoff.

I attached the pricing-scenarios PDF. If you want the $9 / 1M Dedicated scenario to be written into the proposal as an initial offer, confirm here and we'll proceed to formalize.

Best,
Vanessa
